title: manna list --json exits 2 with empty output
description: Found by contracts audit probing 2026-06-12: 'agent-do manna list --json' returns exit 2 and no output while plain 'manna list' works. The --json contract should either work or be undeclared.

title: unbrowse status / swarm status ignore --json
description: Found by contracts audit probing 2026-06-12: both emit prose when --json is passed. Either honor the flag (lib/json-output.sh) or stop advertising it.

title: dns update: promised but agent-dns is a read-only dig wrapper
description: Removed from registry 2026-06-12 per contracts plan escape hatch. DNS record writes belong to agent-namecheap dns-add/dns-update and agent-cloudflare dns-add/dns-update. If a generic dns-write router is wanted, it should delegate to those tools.

title: discord join: voice channels need a gateway connection, not REST
description: Removed from registry 2026-06-12 per contracts plan escape hatch. Joining voice requires a persistent gateway/UDP connection (a daemon like agent-browse's), not a curl call. Build only if a real use case appears.

title: contracts audit: 69 read-surface verbs violate their declared shape
description: First behavioral audit (2026-06-12, .handoff/contracts-audit.md): 68 ok, 102 clean skips, 69 failures — dominated by snapshot verbs that emit prose or nothing under --json (the contracts-plan snapshot shape requires JSON when --json is set), plus probe-bound timeouts (browse clipboard read, calendar list). Fix class-by-class; rerun audit per tool to verify.

title: some probed verb writes a file named --json to cwd
description: After the 68-fix milestone, running 'harness contracts audit' still leaves a PNG file literally named --json in the working directory — some screenshot-ish verb treats the flag as an output path while still exiting 0. Hunt: run audit per-tool and watch for the file. Cosmetic but sloppy.
